description:
Lim Han-yi, a 26-year-old reclusive loner who lives with her older brother.  
Han-yi, who is living a peaceful unemployed life, suddenly face with a crisis due to her brother's marriage, and Han-yi is forced to leave home...  
However, Han-yi has not even dared to go out into the world due to her long life as a reclusive loner.  
Her older brother recommends Han-yi to apply for a reclusive loner role that start in the city at the right time.  
At the reclusive loner center, Han-yi meets a different type of reclusive loner than herself.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=826422), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11160003)
